course_name_en: Fluid Mechanics for Civil Engineering Applications
prerequisites: Students are assumed to have a solid fundamental basis in fluid mechanics and the associated mathematics.

learning_outcomes.text: To provide students with in-depth physical insight into aspects of fluid mechanics that are important for civil engineers, applied to various civil engineering practices.
To understand, learn and apply some elementary calculation and design methods.

syllabus_topics: Scale problems in applied fluid mechanics, turbulence models
Boundary layers, energy transfer mechanisms (flow resistance, surface and form drag)
Potential theory applied to air and water flow, forces on structures and sediment
Potential theory applied to water waves: linear wave theory
Flow in porous media (applied to groundwater flow and well drainage)

assessment_methods.method: Report of completed exercises and assignments

assessment_rules: The assessment consists of a report of completed exercises and assignments, followed by an oral exam. No new report needs to be made if the student passed this component in a previous attempt.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
